How High Diesel Has Really Climbed

According to American Automobile Association data, a federation of motor clubs in North America that tracks daily retail fuel prices across the U.S., diesel averaged $5.60 a gallon on Aug. 31, nearing but not yet surpassing the June 2022 record of $5.816. It has since hit a record nominal high of $5.85, surpassing both the 2022 mark and the figure Greene cited.
A year ago, the national average stood at $3.71 a gallon.
In Georgia, the state Greene represented in Congress, diesel currently averages $5.64 a gallon, slightly below the national figure.
